metadata.title: Vintage Sepia Portrait with Script Overlays

recipe.visualDefinition: A warm, sepia-toned portrait of a smiling woman with voluminous hair, framed by bold, red, expressive hand-drawn script that wraps around the composition with long, energetic flourishes.
coreVisualRelationships: Monochromatic sepia photography contrasted with vibrant red graphic elements
Organic, flowing hair textures mirrored by the fluid motion of the script
Diagonal tension between top-left and bottom-right text placements
coreInvariants: Warm, desaturated brown-gold color palette for the image
High-contrast red for all typographic elements

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central medium-close portrait, slightly tilted to the left, occupying 70% of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's smile and the large red script in the bottom right corner.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the top-left script, follows the hair down to the face, and exits through the large script at the bottom right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Textured, neutral background provides breathing room for the hair and text flourishes.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation in the image with high value contrast; high saturation and medium value in the red text.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to earth tones and one primary accent

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Cursive script with varying stroke weights
letterConstructionRules: Fast, gestural strokes with visible ink-like pressure
Extended horizontal flourishes that underline or overline words
Connected lowercase letters with oversized, expressive capitals
characterSpecificRedesigns: Capitals feature long, sweeping tails that cross the entire width of the composition
Ascenders and descenders are exaggerated for motion
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Expressive, large-scale red script paired with tiny, functional black sans-serif for secondary info.

preserve: The gestural quality of the script
avoid: Geometric sans-serifs for the main title

candidateDirections.reason: Necessary to achieve the specific long flourishes that frame the image

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a grainy, sepia-toned film photograph of a woman with long, wavy 80s-style blonde hair, smiling and looking down. She is wearing a light-colored shirt and suspenders. The background is a textured, neutral studio wall.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large, expressive hand-written script in vibrant red at the top-left and bottom-right. The script should have long, sweeping horizontal tails that act as framing elements. Add a small line of black uppercase sans-serif text tucked under the top-left script.

verificationChecks: Is the red script the most saturated element?
Does the sepia tone feel consistent across the image?
Are the script flourishes long enough to frame the subject?

adjustableVariables: Thickness of the red script strokes
mustRedesign: Any specific artist names or album titles

mustAchieve: Fluid, confident brushwork in the lettering

postGenerationChecks: Check for natural hair texture without AI artifacts
Ensure red script doesn't obscure the subject's eyes or mouth
Verify the sepia palette doesn't look muddy
Confirm the script flourishes feel like a single motion
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a warm-toned film portrait with high-energy, gestural red script that uses long horizontal strokes to frame the composition.
